headline: Last session: Sensex slipped into red after CAS while Nifty gained 75 points; Paytm and crypto stocks remained in focus.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Tuesday, 22 September.

why: Sensex slipped into the red following the CAS while Nifty managed a 75-point gain.
CITI expressed concerns regarding potential additional tariffs by the U.S. impacting global trade.
Crypto stocks tumbled 10% following a setback related to the CLARITY Act.
FII activity and crude oil prices were key factors influencing the market's direction.
whatHappening: Paytm remained in focus as investors assessed opening trends and potential market volatility.
Small-cap stocks showed mixed performance as the broader market indices diverged.
Media stocks saw interest as 'Hanuman Ansh' neared the Rs 300 crore box office milestone.
Traders in Ghaziabad announced a shift to cash-only transactions starting October 15 over UPI MDR fees.
